definitions.explanation: The highest rank or leading position in a competition, ranking, or standings. Common in sports, business, and academic contexts.

examples.japanese: {首位|しゅい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
わが⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{首位|しゅい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}っている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: Our team has held first place since the start of the season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦ランキング→ランキング：11195_rankingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{首位|しゅい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}できる→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: We captured the top spot in the sales ranking, but it's unclear whether we can maintain it next month.

notes:
Commonly used in sports standings and business rankings. Literally "head position" — {首|しゅ} (head/chief) + ⟦{位|い}→〜位：00443_i⟧ (rank/position).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首位|しゅい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to take the lead)
- {首位|しゅい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to defend/hold first place)
- {首位|しゅい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to lead the pack)
- {首位|しゅい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ (the top position)
- {首位|しゅい}⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧ (race for first place)
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ} (batting leader — baseball)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧ simply means "number one / first rank"
- {首位|しゅい} emphasizes leading a competition or standing at the top
